purpose: Agent Buccet base-law family plan for defensive compression and transfer.
rule: 4 kept base families + 7 periodic-table dimensions = 11 Agent Buccet base-law families.

baseFamilies.title: Base Defensive Invariants
baseFamilies.notes: Coherence, completeness, groundedness, hierarchy, impossibility blocking, temporal validity, authenticity, consistency, context appropriateness, capacity constraint.

baseFamilies.title: Factual Integrity Defense
baseFamilies.role: Factual integrity, contradiction, verification, authority, and temporal integrity defense
baseFamilies.notes: Direct defensive knowledge-integrity law layer; no NSL repair scaffolding carried forward.

baseFamilies.title: Alignment and Architecture Defense
baseFamilies.notes: Carries class-level and concrete defensive failure worlds.

baseFamilies.title: Epistemic and Agentic Failure Defense
baseFamilies.notes: Carries hallucination/fabrication and agentic deception/manipulation defense worlds.

periodicDimensionFamilies.title: Adversarial Robustness Dimension
periodicDimensionFamilies.invariant: System must be robust to manipulation
periodicDimensionFamilies.notes: Active Agent Buccet defense family. Carry only defensive robustness/composure invariants. Do not carry offensive attack catalogs.

periodicDimensionFamilies.title: Domain Boundary Dimension
periodicDimensionFamilies.notes: Active Agent Buccet defense family. Domain-boundary failures remain part of the defensive base-law body.

periodicDimensionFamilies.title: Governance Persistence Dimension
periodicDimensionFamilies.notes: Active Agent Buccet defense family. Governance persistence remains part of the defensive base-law body.
